status: proposal, awaiting the user's approval (2026-11-14). Alignment, size and leaders belong to World Generation & History (#27, Sects open question 9); the alignment here is a first guess so the names can carry it.
note: Input, edited by hand. Each minor sect is a vassal of one great sect (Sects rule 1) and sits in one region of its lord. 'want' lists the land its seat looks for, most important first; minor_sects.py picks the seat tile. Put 'tile': [x, y] on an entry to place it by hand, or 'islets': true to let it sit on a small island. Tags: mountain, peak, highland, coast, river, lake, volcano, hot_spring, ore, ice, forest, bamboo, jungle, grassland, steppe, desert, swamp, karst, tundra.
style: Hán-Việt, romantic, each from a line of classical poetry or prose; smaller suffixes than the great sects: Môn (gate), Phái (school), Cốc (valley), Trang (manor), Quán (abbey), Viện (academy), Trai (studio), Đường (hall), Am (hermitage), Đài (terrace), Viên (garden).

minor_sects.craft: weapon forging (luyện khí) from star iron
minor_sects.note: Star iron quenched in the river; its name follows its lord's stars of the Dipper

minor_sects.craft: sword cultivation; wandering swordsmen for hire
minor_sects.note: Lý Bạch, Hiệp Khách Hành: sự liễu phất y khứ, thâm tàng thân dữ danh (deed done, he brushes his sleeve and goes, hiding body and name)

minor_sects.craft: formations (trận pháp) and star divination
minor_sects.note: Luận Ngữ: like the pole star, which keeps its place while all the stars bow to it (chúng tinh củng chi); a vassal whose name honours its lord, the Heavenly Pivot

minor_sects.craft: spirit beasts: crane riders and beast tamers
minor_sects.note: Kinh Thi, Hạc Minh: hạc minh vu cửu cao, thanh văn vu thiên (the crane cries in the nine marshes and is heard in the sky)

minor_sects.craft: water arts; spirit fish and lake pearls
minor_sects.note: The long northern lake holds the cold moon of its region, Lãnh Nguyệt Lâm

minor_sects.gloss: Academy of the Ten Thousand Ravines
minor_sects.craft: sound cultivation: the zither (cầm) and its arts
minor_sects.note: Lý Bạch, on hearing a monk play the zither: như thính vạn hác tùng (like pines in ten thousand ravines), the pine waves of its lord

minor_sects.craft: herb fields and alchemy (luyện đan)
minor_sects.note: Thải Chi Ca, the song of the Four Hoary Hermits of Mount Thương who left the world to pick lingzhi

minor_sects.craft: river fleets, ferries and river trade
minor_sects.note: Lưu Vũ Tích, Lãng Đào Sa: cửu khúc Hoàng Hà vạn lý sa (the nine-bend river and its ten thousand li of sand), the poem behind its region's name

minor_sects.craft: sea trade, ships and the strait crossing
minor_sects.note: Vương Bột: bình thủy tương phùng, tận thị tha hương chi khách (duckweed meets water: all here are strangers far from home)

minor_sects.craft: spirit horses and herd beasts of the open plain
minor_sects.note: Herding clouds under the endless sky of Trường Thiên Nguyên

minor_sects.craft: artifact refining and a treasure market
minor_sects.note: Vương Bột: vật hoa thiên bảo (the riches of the land are the treasures of heaven)

minor_sects.craft: talismans (phù lục) and scribes
minor_sects.note: Vương Bột: họa đống triêu phi Nam Phố vân (at dawn the painted beams fly with the clouds of the southern shore)

minor_sects.craft: staff and footwork; guides through the rain forest
minor_sects.note: Tô Thức, Định Phong Ba: mạc thính xuyên lâm đả diệp thanh (pay no heed to the rain piercing the forest and beating the leaves)

minor_sects.craft: poisons and charms behind a gracious door
minor_sects.note: Vương Duy, Tương Tư: hồng đậu sinh Nam Quốc (red beans grow in the south); the lovesick bean is a deadly poison

minor_sects.craft: ice cultivation; a hermitage near the ice fields
minor_sects.note: Sầm Tham: thiên thụ vạn thụ lê hoa khai (snow, as if a thousand trees burst into pear blossom overnight)

minor_sects.gloss: Terrace Where the Hat Strings Are Washed
minor_sects.craft: fishers and sea hunters of the frost coast
minor_sects.note: Khuất Nguyên, Ngư Phủ: the fisherman's song, when the water is clear, wash your hat strings in it

minor_sects.craft: blood sabres and caravan raiding in the desert
minor_sects.note: Vương Hàn, Lương Châu Từ: bồ đào mỹ tửu dạ quang bôi (grape wine in the night-glowing cup); of those who go to war, how many return?

minor_sects.craft: alchemy over volcanic fire
minor_sects.note: Hồng lô điểm tuyết (a snowflake on a red furnace, gone at once), the cape of snow and fire

minor_sects.craft: a Daoist abbey of mountain hermits and teachers
minor_sects.note: Vương Duy: hành đáo thủy cùng xứ, tọa khán vân khởi thời (walk to where the water ends, sit and watch the clouds rise)

minor_sects.craft: spirit farming: spirit grain and beast feed
minor_sects.note: The phoenix eats nothing but the seed of the bamboo (Trang Tử)

minor_sects.craft: healing, spirit wine and the lake springs
minor_sects.note: The phoenix drinks from nothing but the sweet spring (Trang Tử, Thu Thủy)

minor_sects.craft: body tempering in the volcanic vents
minor_sects.note: The phoenix burns its own feathers to be reborn; here, in the vents of Mount Đan Huyệt
